result.stdout:
Screen a real lv-draft or offline lv-draft JSON snapshot for structural validity
and usable timeline facts.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --ref TEXT Excludes: --input 
                              Unified draft reference to inspect, for example
                              local://my_project.
          --input TEXT:FILE Excludes: --ref 
                              Offline lv-draft JSON snapshot to inspect without opening a draft
                              runtime.
          --suite TEXT [structure,timeline,resource,property,layout,spatial,occlusion]  
                              CSV suites:
                              structure,timeline,resource,resource-availability,property,layout,spatial,occlusion,all.
                              The all suite excludes resource-availability.
          --require-segment   Require at least one segment-like object in the inspected draft.
          --require-contiguous 
                              Report timeline gaps as errors; gaps are facts by default.
          --require-timeline-evidence 
                              Reject when segment-like entries do not expose normalized
                              timeline evidence.
          --local-resource-root TEXT:DIR ... 
                              Trusted root containing local material files; repeat for multiple
                              roots.
          --spatial-overlap-threshold FLOAT:FLOAT in [0 - 1] [0.010000]  
                              Minimum intersection-over-union reported as a spatial overlap
                              risk.
          --occlusion-threshold FLOAT:FLOAT in [0 - 1] [0.300000]  
                              Minimum fraction of the rear element covered by the front
                              element.
          --spatial-overlap-severity TEXT:{warning,error} [warning]  
                              Severity for spatial overlap findings: warning or error.
          --occlusion-severity TEXT:{warning,error} [warning]  
                              Severity for z-order/opacity occlusion-risk findings: warning or
                              error.
          --require-spatial-evidence 
                              Reject when spatial/occlusion suites cannot obtain time, bbox,
                              z-order, or opacity evidence.
          --output TEXT       Write the screening report JSON.
          --fail-on TEXT:{error,never} [error]  
                              Exit policy: error or never.
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  $ lyra-cli lint command --suite registry,schema,docs,acceptance,workflow
  $ lyra-cli lint command --capability draft.video.add --acceptance-level L0
  $ lyra-cli lint command --run --acceptance-level L1
  $ lyra-cli lint media --input ./output.mp4 --expected-kind video
  $ lyra-cli lint algorithm-effect --algorithm draft.algo.ai-matting --baseline ./source.mp4 --candidate ./alpha.mp4 --artifacts ./algorithm-effect-artifacts --output ./algorithm-effect.json
  $ lyra-cli lint draft --ref local://my_project --require-segment
  $ lyra-cli lint draft --input /absolute/path/to/draft_info.json --require-segment
  $ lyra-cli lint draft --ref local://my_project --suite resource,resource-availability --local-resource-root ./draft

LEARN MORE
  `lint command` orchestrates acceptance; result lint commands provide report-only evidence.
